# Wemble

> Wemble Development Corporation. One human signs filings. AI agents do the rest. The goal is a company that runs, learns, and grows with as little human as possible.

The public homepage at https://wemble.com is a stealth holding page on purpose. It is not a catalog. This file is the index for agents. The catalog is [llms-full.txt](https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt).

## Products

- [Fitnito](https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt#fitnito): LIVE independent gym and studio SaaS (schedule, member booking, passes, optional Stripe). Full product brief: https://fitnito.com/llms-full.txt
- [Fitify](https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt#fitify): LIVE. Playful daily tips so people who hate fitness can count ordinary life as exercise. Not the Czech app at gofitify.com.
- [Healthware](https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt#healthware): IN THE LAB. Health tools that do not look like 1997. Med Interaction Checker planned. Not shipped.

## Company

- [Wemble](https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt#wemble): Legal entity, how it runs, contact.
- [GitHub wembledev](https://github.com/wembledev): Public repos (DashBot, dashbot-openclaw, voice-agent).
